items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: my uncle, my uncle George Wilson, buddy, we call him buddy, was telling me about somebody close in the family

ctx.x: We were talking about, you said, a lot of blacks and whites. The neighborhood you lived in up in Shrewsbury, was it all black?

Yeah, well, right, right, right, on Causeway all the way back, it was all black. Now, on, on, on, on, on Claybone Drive was white. We used to call it subdivision, that was white over there. But Causeway, and, and, and, and the, and the, the side street, all that was, all that, you know, like Andover Street. Well, well, that was black. Now, blacks were all the way over to Severn Avenue. And one street over, well, that was, um, what is it, man, man used to have a garden back there. Cause I remember when I was a…
Did you, do you remember a, a birthday party for yourself? Or do you remember?
